purpose: Separate semantic certification from current-product evidence eligibility so historical or replaced evidence may remain semantically certifiable without being allowed to prove current-product repeatability.

legacy_version_status_boundary.rationale: Legacy certification builders populate version_status without consulting temporal governance. The field may describe the certification case's intended version applicability but cannot establish current product evidence eligibility.
legacy_version_status_boundary.reason_for_deferral: Renaming the legacy field across certification builders is metadata cleanup, not a safety prerequisite after the governed current-product evidence-eligibility gate. Avoid broad churn in proven certification code before the next cold-start experiment.

all_conditions_required: product identity matches the experiment target entity exactly
document identity resolution status is resolved

non_goals: do not make historical documents semantically uncertifiable
do not move temporal decision authority into rule certification
do not change planner CURRENT_APPLICABLE request semantics
do not change the frozen Product #7 v4.1 preregistration
do not authorize Product #8 or Motor
